headline: Prediction: Up 100% in a Year. Will CAT’s Rally Continue?
summary: Caterpillar has quietly become one of Wall Street's most unexpected AI infrastructure plays, but a 10% pullback from all-time highs and mounting tariff costs raise a critical question about whether the bull case still holds.
